decision: The exact final native runtime provides lower pooled p50 and p95 in all eight registered query cells and lower total time in all four ingestion cells, with full recorded output/index/source equivalence. Default-budget p95 improves in 15/16 paired rounds and all ingestion pairs improve. Explicitly retain and accept the smaller regressing rounds, startup/RSS and binary-size costs. The complete same-source 30-cell native delivery preparation and independent asset/source/log audit passed, including native/fallback default installation and source installation. Accept this exact runtime for release; actual publication still requires exact-final-commit CI, matching main/release identity, a fresh complete native matrix and verified public installation.

No change to SQL/schema/algorithm, identities, source positions, ranking decisions, scopes, budgets or cache behavior. The original Python text join remains after its C replacement measured slower.

accepted_costs: Synthetic direct recall at 2400 characters regresses 0.8917455% at p95 in chronological round 2; its pooled p95 improves 1.8232883%. This negative observation is retained, not declared noise.

Public MCP with the 1024-token configuration regresses 0.7750802% at p50 and 3.1777649% at p95 in chronological round 1; pooled p50/p95 improve 2.4229535%/1.1196770%. All original observations remain.
API import increases 2.0432325 ms for synthetic and 2.19728 ms for public data (four-worker medians), about 4.55%/4.95%; this is not full process or CLI startup.
New-database opening increases approximately 0.102/0.0545 ms and existing-database opening 0.0118/0.0140 ms for synthetic/public data.
MCP startup is mixed: character-budget initialization changes -4.262/+7.352 ms and token-budget initialization -14.932/+0.754 ms for synthetic/public cohorts. No universal startup benefit is claimed.
Ending worker RSS increases approximately 0.2324/0.0176 MiB and peak RSS 0.1406/0.0215 MiB. All 38 resource cells retain four observations per side and exact boundaries; no memory-saving claim.
The measured host extension grows from 126648 to 646128 bytes (+519480); this is not a wheel-download or all-platform installation-size claim.

Cumulative worker CPU includes probe/bootstrap/ingestion/evaluation/validation. Per-call MCP CPU belongs to the client; server CPU is separately measured from live snapshots with procfs tick granularity.
All paired checkpointed DB/WAL/SHM sizes remain equal; live storage snapshots are preserved separately.

prior_attempts.reason: Unchanged reingestion regressed 19.4149%/21.4095% with all eight paired cohort rounds slower. Complete original data/audit retained.

Performance measurements improved, but CPython 3.14/3.15 native packaging exposed exact unpack-exception incompatibility. Complete original performance results/audit retained; repaired source required the separate full protocol5 run.

development_evidence.policy: Retain all local batches and unfavorable results; local diagnostics do not replace the final hosted measurements.
development_evidence.python_join_decision: All three measured public wrapper configurations were slower through the attempted C join, so the original Python function was restored. No algorithm or data changes.

timing_boundaries.api_import: Import MemoryBook in a fresh worker after the common evaluator/bootstrap imports; this is not full CLI/process startup.
timing_boundaries.cache: No query-result hits. SQLite/OS caches are not cleared; token-count memo warms naturally. No timed-call warmup or discarded sample.
timing_boundaries.ingestion: Complete fresh and unchanged session batches, with ordinary list append overhead inside the batch timer. Raw ordered responses and hashes are retained outside timing; four paired batches per cohort.
timing_boundaries.mcp: Official SDK call_tool round trip including server recall, normal cache write, serialization and transport; result-cache clear/validation excluded
timing_boundaries.native: MemoryBook.recall only, including exact optional-token budget work; validation/hash/ledger excluded
timing_boundaries.probe: An identical isolated non-corpus wrapper suite precedes measured database creation and may warm process code/import/regex/SQLite-library state. No measured database or tokenizer vocabulary is warmed.
timing_boundaries.resource_cpu: Native calling-process CPU per call; MCP calling-process CPU is CLIENT only. Server live snapshots separately include startup/calls/background process lifetime.
timing_boundaries.tokens: Reference cl100k_base vocabulary initialized in worker before token calls; each fresh MCP token server retains its natural first-call initialization cost.
